CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_FINANCIALPRODUCT_TRY
AS
BEGIN

INSERT INTO BNKM.FinancialProduct(FinancialProductId, FinancialProductName, SourceSystemCode, WorkFlowId, TaskRunId, InsertDttm,SourceCode,FinancialInstitutionId)
SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5','Diamond Savings Account'),1) AS FinancialProductId, 'Diamond Savings Account' AS FinancialProductName, 'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode, 0 AS WorkFlowId, 0 AS TaskRunId, GetDate() AS InsertDttm, 'TRY','CBC01'
UNION
SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5','Treasury Certificate of Deposit'),1) AS FinancialProductId, 'Treasury Certificate of Deposit' AS FinancialProductName, 'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode, 0 AS WorkFlowId, 0 AS TaskRunId, GetDate() AS InsertDttm ,'TRY','CBC01'
UNION
SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5','Restricted Treasury Certificate of Deposit'),1) AS FinancialProductId, 'Restricted Treasury Certificate of Deposit' AS FinancialProductName, 'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode, 0 AS WorkFlowId, 0 AS TaskRunId, GetDate() AS InsertDttm ,'TRY','CBC01'
UNION
SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5','Promissory Note'),1) AS FinancialProductId, 'Promissory Note' AS FinancialProductName, 'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode, 0 AS WorkFlowId, 0 AS TaskRunId, GetDate() AS InsertDttm,'TRY','CBC01'

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5','BSP Bills'),1) AS FinancialProductId, 'BSP Bills' AS FinancialProductName, 'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode, 0 AS WorkFlowId, 0 AS TaskRunId, GetDate() AS InsertDttm,'TRY','CBC01'

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5','Retail Treasury Bonds (RTBs)'),1) AS FinancialProductId, 'Retail Treasury Bonds (RTBs)' AS FinancialProductName, 'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode, 0 AS WorkFlowId, 0 AS TaskRunId, GetDate() AS InsertDttm,'TRY','CBC01'

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5','FX Swap'),1) AS FinancialProductId, 'FX Swap' AS FinancialProductName, 'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode, 0 AS WorkFlowId, 0 AS TaskRunId, GetDate() AS InsertDttm,'TRY','CBC01'

SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(64),HASHBYTES('MD5','Asset Swap'),1) AS FinancialProductId, 'Asset Swap' AS FinancialProductName, 'TRY' AS SourceSystemCode, 0 AS WorkFlowId, 0 AS TaskRunId, GetDate() AS InsertDttm,'TRY','CBC01'

END
